plugins.name: Cross-Project Knowledge
plugins.description: Link projects that talk to each other (a mobile app, a web API, the NuGet or npm package with their models) and see the contracts they serialize and deserialize, the endpoints between them and the packages they share, drawn as a map, with drift flagged. Agents get the same links as tools.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Example: hello
plugins.description: Example of every plugin feature: an agent CLI (Gemini), a recipe, palette and voice tools, and code.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Knowledge Base
plugins.description: Turns each project into a graphify knowledge graph you explore as a live 3D galaxy or a flat 2D map. Agents query it with tools and you watch what they look at.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Secrets
plugins.description: Keep API keys, environment variables and logins in your keychain. Agents use them by name without ever seeing the values.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Task Board
plugins.description: A shared board per workspace where agents post, claim and finish tasks and leave notes for each other, so several agents work as a team.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Telegram
plugins.description: Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, and approve, decline or answer it from your phone while you're away.
plugins.author: winfer
